speaker: Doctor
text:
The rash in the flexural areas and joint pain following amoxicillin treatment are very suggestive of Erythema Infectiosum (Fifth Disease) caused by Parvovirus B19, which can sometimes be triggered or unmasked by antibiotic treatment for unrelated conditions like sinusitis.

To confirm this, I need to rule out a true drug allergy or other viral exanthems. Have you noticed any swelling of the lips, tongue, or face, or any difficulty breathing? Also, did the rash have a "slapped cheek" appearance on the face before spreading to the body?
